verses.en: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz did see.
verses.pt: Revelação sobre a Babilônia, vista por Isaías, filho de Amoz.
verses.en_web: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw.
verses.en_bbe: The word of the Lord about Babylon which Isaiah, the son of Amoz, saw.

verses.en: Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain, exalt the voice unto them, shake the hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.
verses.pt: Levantai uma bandeira sobre um alto monte, levantai a voz a eles; movei a mão ao alto, para que entrem pelas portas dos príncipes.
verses.en_web: Set up a banner on the bare mountain! Lift up your voice to them! Wave your hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.
verses.en_bbe: Put up a flag on a clear mountain-top, make a loud outcry to them, give directions with the hand, so that they may go into the doors of the great ones.

verses.en: I have commanded my sanctified ones, I have also called my mighty ones for mine anger, even them that rejoice in my highness.
verses.pt: Eu dei ordens aos meus santificados; também chamei aos meus guerreiros para minha ira, aos que se alegram com minha glória.
verses.en_web: I have commanded my consecrated ones; yes, I have called my mighty men for my anger, even my proudly exulting ones.
verses.en_bbe: I have given orders to my holy ones, I have sent out my men of war, those of mine who take pride in their power, to give effect to my wrath.

verses.en: The noise of a multitude in the mountains, like as of a great people; a tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together: the LORD of hosts mustereth the host of the battle.
verses.pt: Há um ruído de tumulto sobre os montes, como o de um imenso povo; ruído de multidões de reinos de nações reunidas; o SENHOR dos exércitos está revistando um exército para a guerra.
verses.en_web: The noise of a multitude is in the mountains, as of a great people; the noise of an uproar of the kingdoms of the nations gathered together! Yahweh of Armies is mustering the army for the battle.
verses.en_bbe: The noise of great numbers in the mountains, like the noise of a strong people! The noise of the kingdoms of the nations meeting together! The Lord of armies is numbering his forces for war.

verses.en: They come from a far country, from the end of heaven, even the LORD, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.
verses.pt: Eles vêm de uma terra distante, desde a extremidade do céu; o SENHOR e os instrumentos de seu furor, para destruir toda aquela terra.
verses.en_web: They come from a far country, from the uttermost part of heaven, even Yahweh, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.
verses.en_bbe: They come from a far country, from the farthest part of heaven, even the Lord and the instruments of his wrath, with destruction for all the land.

verses.en: Howl ye; for the day of the LORD is at hand; it shall come as a destruction from the Almighty.
verses.pt: Gritai lamentando, pois o dia do SENHOR está perto; vem como assolação pelo Todo-Poderoso.
verses.en_web: Wail; for the day of Yahweh is at hand! It will come as destruction from the Almighty.
verses.en_bbe: Send out a cry of grief; for the day of the Lord is near; it comes as destruction from the Most High.

verses.en: Therefore shall all hands be faint, and every man’s heart shall melt:
verses.pt: Por isso todas as mãos ficarão fracas, e o coração de todos os homens se derreterá.
verses.en_web: Therefore all hands will be feeble, and everyone’s heart will melt.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause all hands will be feeble, and every heart of man be turned to water;

verses.en: And they shall be afraid: pangs and sorrows shall take hold of them; they shall be in pain as a woman that travaileth: they shall be amazed one at another; their faces shall be as flames.
verses.pt: E ficarão aterrorizados; serão tomados por dores e angústias; sofrerão como mulher com dores de parto; cada um terá medo de seu próximo, seus rostos serão rostos em chamas.
verses.en_web: They will be dismayed. Pangs and sorrows will seize them. They will be in pain like a woman in labor. They will look in amazement one at another. Their faces will be faces of flame.
verses.en_bbe: Their hearts will be full of fear; pains and sorrows will overcome them; they will be in pain like a woman in childbirth; they will be shocked at one another; their faces will be like flames.

verses.en: Behold, the day of the LORD cometh, cruel both with wrath and fierce anger, to lay the land desolate: and he shall destroy the sinners thereof out of it.
verses.pt: Eis que o dia do SENHOR vem horrendo, com furor e ira ardente, para pôr a terra em assolação, e destruir os pecadores nela.
verses.en_web: Behold, the day of Yahweh comes, cruel, with wrath and fierce anger; to make the land a desolation, and to destroy its sinners out of it.
verses.en_bbe: See, the day of the Lord is coming, cruel, with wrath and burning passion: to make the land a waste, driving the sinners in it to destruction.

verses.en: For the stars of heaven and the constellations thereof shall not give their light: the sun shall be darkened in his going forth, and the moon shall not cause her light to shine.
verses.pt: Porque as estrelas dos céus e suas constelações não darão sua luz; o sol se escurecerá ao nascer, e a lua não brilhará com sua luz.
verses.en_web: For the stars of the sky and its constellations will not give their light. The sun will be darkened in its going out, and the moon will not cause its light to shine.
verses.en_bbe: For the stars of heaven and its bright armies will not give their light: the sun will be made dark in his journey through the heaven, and the moon will keep back her light.

verses.en: And I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity; and I will cause the arrogancy of the proud to cease, and will lay low the haughtiness of the terrible.
verses.pt: Porque visitarei para punir sobre o mundo a maldade, e sobre os maus sua perversidade; e porei fim à arrogância dos soberbos, e abaterei o orgulho dos tiranos.
verses.en_web: I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity. I will cause the arrogance of the proud to cease, and will humble the haughtiness of the terrible.
verses.en_bbe: And I will send punishment on the world for its evil, and on the sinners for their wrongdoing; and I will put an end to all pride, and will make low the power of the cruel.

verses.en: I will make a man more precious than fine gold; even a man than the golden wedge of Ophir.
verses.pt: Farei com que um varão seja mais raro que o ouro maciço, e um homem mais que o ouro fino de Ofir.
verses.en_web: I will make people more rare than fine gold, even a person than the pure gold of Ophir.
verses.en_bbe: I will make men so small in number, that a man will be harder to get than gold, even the best gold of Ophir.

verses.en: Therefore I will shake the heavens, and the earth shall remove out of her place, in the wrath of the LORD of hosts, and in the day of his fierce anger.
verses.pt: Por isso farei estremecer aos céus, e a terra se moverá de seu lugar, por causa do furor do SENHOR dos exércitos, e por causa de sua ardente ira.
verses.en_web: Therefore I will make the heavens tremble, and the earth will be shaken out of its place in Yahweh of Armies’ wrath, and in the day of his fierce anger.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause the heavens will be shaking, and the earth will be moved out of its place, in the wrath of the Lord of armies, and in the day of his burning passion.

verses.en: And it shall be as the chased roe, and as a sheep that no man taketh up: they shall every man turn to his own people, and flee every one into his own land.
verses.pt: E será que, como uma corça em fuga, e como uma ovelha que ninguém recolhe, cada um se voltará para seu povo, e cada um fugirá para sua terra.
verses.en_web: It will happen that like a hunted gazelle, and like sheep that no one gathers, they will each turn to their own people, and will each flee to their own land.
verses.en_bbe: And it will be that, like a roe in flight, and like wandering sheep, they will go every man to his people and to his land.

verses.en: Every one that is found shall be thrust through; and every one that is joined unto them shall fall by the sword.
verses.pt: Qualquer um que for achado, será traspassado; e qualquer um que se juntar a ele cairá pela espada.
verses.en_web: Everyone who is found will be thrust through. Everyone who is captured will fall by the sword.
verses.en_bbe: Everyone who is overtaken will have a spear put through him, and everyone who goes in flight will be put to the sword.

verses.en: Their children also shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses shall be spoiled, and their wives ravished.
verses.pt: E suas crianças serão despedaçadas perante seus olhos; suas casas serão saqueadas, e suas mulheres estupradas.
verses.en_web: Their infants also will be dashed in pieces before their eyes. Their houses will be ransacked, and their wives raped.
verses.en_bbe: Their young children will be broken up before their eyes; their goods will be taken away, and their wives made the property of others.

verses.en: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight in it.
verses.pt: Eis que despertarei contra eles aos medos, que não se importarão com a prata, nem desejarão ouro.
verses.en_web: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, who will not value silver, and as for gold, they will not delight in it.
verses.en_bbe: See, I am driving the Medes against them, who put no value on silver and have no pleasure in gold.

verses.en: Their bows also shall dash the young men to pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not spare children.
verses.pt: E com seus arcos despedaçarão aos rapazes, e não terão piedade do fruto do ventre; o olho deles não terá compaixão das crianças.
verses.en_web: Their bows will dash the young men in pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb. Their eyes will not spare children.
verses.en_bbe: In their hands are bows and spears; they are cruel, violently putting the young men to death, and crushing the young women; they have no pity for children, and no mercy for the fruit of the body.

verses.en: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees’ excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
verses.pt: Assim será Babilônia, a joia dos reinos, a beleza e o orgulho dos caldeus, semelhante a Sodoma e Gomorra, quando Deus as arruinou.
verses.en_web: Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldeans’ pride, will be like when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
verses.en_bbe: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beautiful town which is the pride of the Chaldaeans, will be like God's destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah.

verses.en: It shall never be inhabited, neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation: neither shall the Arabian pitch tent there; neither shall the shepherds make their fold there.
verses.pt: Nunca mais será habitada, nem nela se morará, de geração em geração; nem o árabe armará ali sua tenda, nem os pastores farão descansar ali seus rebanhos.
verses.en_web: It will never be inhabited, neither will it be lived in from generation to generation. The Arabian will not pitch a tent there, neither will shepherds make their flocks lie down there.
verses.en_bbe: People will never be living in it again, and it will have no more men from generation to generation: the Arab will not put up his tent there; and those who keep sheep will not make it a resting-place for their flocks.

verses.en: But wild beasts of the desert shall lie there; and their houses shall be full of doleful creatures; and owls shall dwell there, and satyrs shall dance there.
verses.pt: Mas os animais selvagens do deserto ali descansarão, e suas casas se encherão de animais medonhos; e ali habitarão corujas, e bodes selvagens saltarão ali.
verses.en_web: But wild animals of the desert will lie there, and their houses will be full of jackals. Ostriches will dwell there, and wild goats will frolic there.
verses.en_bbe: But the beasts of the waste land will have their holes there; and the houses will be full of crying jackals, and ostriches will have their place there, and evil spirits will be dancing there.

verses.en: And the wild beasts of the islands shall cry in their desolate houses, and dragons in their pleasant palaces: and her time is near to come, and her days shall not be prolonged.
verses.pt: E as hienas uivarão em suas fortalezas, e chacais em seus confortáveis palácios. Pois está chegando bem perto o seu tempo, e os dias dela não se prolongarão.
verses.en_web: Wolves will cry in their fortresses, and jackals in the pleasant palaces. Her time is near to come, and her days will not be prolonged.
verses.en_bbe: And wolves will be answering one another in their towers, and jackals in their houses of pleasure: her time is near, and her days of power will quickly be ended.
